queue.title: Clinical Practice Guidelines by Infectious Diseases Society of America (IDSA): 2025 Guidelines on Management and Treatment of Complicated Urinary Tract Infections--Duration of Antibiotics for Complicated UTI.
queue.journal: Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America
queue.abstract:
BACKGROUND: These recommendations provide guidance on the optimal duration of antibiotics in patients with complicated urinary tract infection (cUTI), especially in presence of associated Gram-negative bacteremia.
METHODS: The panel's recommendations are based upon evidence derived from systematic literature reviews which focused on comparative benefits and harms of shorter (5-7 days) vs prolonged (10-14 days) duration of antibiotics, including publications since 2000. These recommendations adhere to a standardized methodology for rating the certainty of evidence and strength of recommendation according to the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation) approach.
RESULTS: The guidelines panel suggests that patients with cUTI who are improving on effective therapy can be treated with shorter duration of antimicrobials (either 5-7 days of a fluoroquinolone or 7 days of a non-fluoroquinolone) rather than longer courses of antibiotics, regardless of the presence of associated Gram-negative bacteremia. An effective antimicrobial agent achieves therapeutic levels in the urine and relevant tissue and is active against the causative pathogen. However, men with febrile UTI in whom acute bacterial prostatitis is suspected may benefit from a longer treatment duration (10-14 days), and a short courses of oral beta lactams may require higher doses for efficacy.
CONCLUSIONS: Shorter durations of antibiotics for cUTI provide similar efficacy as longer courses, except in men with febrile UTI in whom acute bacterial prostatitis is suspected. This recommendation places a high value on antibiotic stewardship considerations as well as reducing the burden of antimicrobial administration from a healthcare perspective and reducing the burden of taking antibiotics from a patient perspective.

Serious adverse events were rare, and available evidence did not show consistent increases in exacerbations of underlying immunocompromising conditions. Most studies had short follow-up durations, likely reflecting higher-end estimates of vaccine effectiveness. Given moderate certainty of benefit and low certainty of harm, the panel strongly recommends the 2025-2026 COVID-19 vaccine for all immunocompromised individuals aged ≥6 months, with timing tailored to immunosuppressive therapy, clinical stability, and community transmission levels. Adjunct strategies-including vaccination of household contacts and early antiviral access-remain essential. Research priorities include defining immunologic correlates of protection, evaluating durability, optimizing vaccine timing, and improving real-world effectiveness and safety data.

We aimed to evaluate the prevalence and predictors of OACs and/or aspirin use among veterans with AF in Veterans Affairs nursing homes in the era after the guideline publication.

SETTING AND PARTICIPANTS: Four thousand nine hundred ninety-four nursing home residents with AF and a CHADS-VASc score of ≥2.
METHODS: Multinomial logistic regression was used to compare demographics, comorbidities, functional status, and concurrent antiplatelet medication use in residents who received OAC ± aspirin and aspirin alone, compared with neither.
RESULTS: In the era after the 2014 American College of Cardiology/American Heart Association guideline was released, age-standardized prevalence rates for any OAC (warfarin and direct oral anticoagulant) increased from 31.2% in fiscal year (FY) 2013 to 2014 to 46.6% in FY 2019. In addition, there was a decrease in patients receiving no OAC (21.1%-16.2%) and aspirin (47.7%-39.3%). However, some eligible residents remained untreated. Averaged over FY 2015 to 2019, each decade of ascending age was associated with a lower likelihood of receiving OAC [relative risk ratio (RRR), 0.79; 95% CI, 0.71-0.87], relative to neither anticoagulant nor aspirin use. Black veterans were less likely to receive OAC (RRR, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.58-0.91); Hispanic veterans were less likely to receive OAC (RRR, 0.63; 95% CI, 0.44-0.91) and aspirin (RRR, 0.47; 95% CI, 0.31-0.72). Mild to moderate cognitive impairment, greater disability, and other antiplatelet use were also associated with less OAC use.
CONCLUSIONS AND IMPLICATIONS: Fewer Veterans Affairs nursing home residents received OACs than recommended by guidelines, with significant differences by age and race/ethnicity. Future research efforts should aim to understand the reasons for low OAC use and to augment the evidence base for anticoagulant use to include frail older adults.

queue.title: Workup and management of rhythm disorders in myocarditis and inflammatory cardiomyopathy: a clinical consensus statement of the European Heart Rhythm Association and the Heart Failure Association of the ESC, the ESC Working Group on Myocardial & Pericardial Diseases, the European Association of Preventive Cardiology of the ESC, the Heart Rhythm Society, the Asian Pacific Heart Rhythm Society, and the Latin American Heart Rhythm Society.
queue.abstract: Myocarditis is an important and frequently underrecognized cause of atrioventricular conduction disease and ventricular arrhythmias and may also be associated with atrial arrhythmias and sinus node dysfunction. Arrhythmic risk evolves over time as a result of the interplay between myocardial inflammation, fibrosis, and genetic predisposition. Despite its clinical relevance, guidance for the diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of arrhythmias in myocarditis has remained limited. This consensus statement provides a structured framework for the management of arrhythmias in myocarditis and inflammatory cardiomyopathy (Infl-CMP), integrating disease phase and genetic background into clinical decision-making. It offers practical guidance across the disease spectrum, including diagnostic evaluation, therapeutic strategies, and longitudinal follow-up. The document was jointly developed by the European Heart Rhythm Association of the European Society of Cardiology (ESC) in collaboration with the Heart Failure Association of the ESC, the ESC Working Group on Myocardial & Pericardial Diseases, and the European Association of Preventive Cardiology of the ESC, together with the Heart Rhythm Society, the Asia Pacific Heart Rhythm Society, and the Latin American Heart Rhythm Society. Consensus advice is organized using a phase-aware framework distinguishing hot, hot-to-cold, and cold phases, with clinical consensus statements graded according to opinion-, observational-, or randomized trial-based evidence and supported by formal author voting. Arrhythmia management is stratified by disease phase. During active inflammation, antiarrhythmic therapy is combined with aetiology-targeted treatment or immunosuppression when indicated. In later stages, substrate-based strategies include pharmacological therapy, device implantation, or ablation. Emphasis is placed on hot-to-cold transition as an arrhythmogenic window and on risk stratification.

The guideline also discusses the roles of upper endoscopy and surgery in the setting of acute LGIB and outlines the absolute and relative contraindications of colonoscopy. queue.abstract: Very rare and ultra-rare primary inherited arrhythmia syndromes (IAS) represent a heterogeneous group of disorders associated with a significant risk of sudden cardiac death, often manifesting from foetal life to early adulthood. Current guidelines primarily address more common IAS and provide limited, non-specific recommendations for these rare entities, particularly in paediatric populations. This European Heart Rhythm Association Clinical Consensus Statement, developed in collaboration with the Association of Cardiovascular Nursing and Allied Professions and endorsed by the Association for European Paediatric and Congenital Cardiology, integrates available evidence with expert opinion. Recommendations were formulated through structured discussion and voting, following ESC consensus methodology, with a focus on clinically actionable gene-disease associations. The document provides a comprehensive framework for the diagnosis and management of very rare IAS, including calmodulinopathies, Andersen-Tawil syndrome, Timothy syndrome, TRDN-related disease, calcium release deficiency syndrome, and other atypical channelopathies. It highlights age-specific clinical presentations, the importance of genetic testing, and tailored therapeutic strategies, including pharmacological treatments, left cardiac sympathetic denervation, and selective use of implantable cardioverter-defibrillators. Special attention is given to paediatric considerations, foetal diagnosis, and the role of multidisciplinary care. The document also addresses arrhythmic risk in metabolic and cardiomyopathic conditions, as well as the importance of molecular autopsy and family screening in sudden unexplained death. This consensus document fills a critical gap by providing expert-driven, pragmatic guidance for the management of very rare IAS across the lifespan. It underscores the need for specialized care, international collaboration, and prospective registries to improve evidence generation, risk stratification, and patient outcomes in this vulnerable population.

queue.title: Optimal lifelong roadmap post-acute coronary syndrome: a clinical consensus statement of the European Association of Preventive Cardiology of the European Society of Cardiology.
queue.abstract: Acute coronary syndromes (ACSs) remain a major cause of mortality and morbidity across Europe, with long-term outcomes still sub-optimal despite advances in acute care. Current clinical guidelines primarily focus on the immediate post-event phase, providing limited direction on extended follow-up and integrated care strategies. Furthermore, there is considerable heterogeneity across European healthcare systems regarding the implementation of post-ACS services, resulting in disparities in patient outcomes and access to preventive care. The aim of this clinical consensus statement, developed by the European Association of Preventive Cardiology (EAPC) of the European Society of Cardiology, is to define an optimal, lifelong roadmap for patients following an ACS. It proposes a structured, phased model of care that supports evidence-informed, equitable, and patient-centred management strategies adaptable to national and local contexts. The roadmap targets multiple patient phenotypes, promoting continuity of care, collaboration among healthcare professionals, and integration of technological solutions. The methodology employed involved a multidisciplinary expert group nominated by the EAPC. Through structured literature review, expert consensus, and iterative discussions, the panel defined key components of post-ACS care across different phases of recovery. The final roadmap integrates best available evidence, clinical expertise, and practical considerations to support implementation across diverse healthcare settings.

summary: Give IV thrombolysis within 4.5 h with either tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg (max 25 mg) single IV bolus OR alteplase 0.9 mg/kg (max 90 mg; 10% bolus then 60-min infusion) — both now Class 1 to improve functional outcomes, tenecteplase favored for single-bolus simplicity.

In patients with salvageable penumbra on automated perfusion imaging, IV thrombolysis is reasonable 4.5–9 h from last known well or within 9 h of the midpoint of sleep in wake-up stroke (Class 2a); may be considered 4.5–24 h in LVO patients who cannot undergo thrombectomy (Class 2b).

Endovascular thrombectomy is now Class 1 for selected anterior-circulation LVO up to 24 h (age <80, NIHSS ≥6, ASPECTS 3–5 without significant mass effect), and Class 1 for basilar artery occlusion within 24 h (NIHSS ≥10, PC-ASPECTS ≥6).
Do NOT intensively lower blood pressure to <140 mmHg systolic after thrombolysis (Class 3, no benefit) or within 72 h after successful thrombectomy (Class 3, harm).
Do NOT target tight glucose 80–130 mg/dL with IV insulin (Class 3, no benefit / hypoglycemia risk); a target of 140–180 mg/dL remains reasonable.
Deploy mobile stroke units where feasible to shorten time to thrombolysis (Class 1).
For minor stroke (NIHSS ≤5) or high-risk TIA of presumed atherosclerotic cause, start dual antiplatelet therapy (clopidogrel + aspirin) for 21 days then single antiplatelet (Class 2a).
First-ever pediatric recommendations: IV thrombolysis within 4.5 h for confirmed AIS ages 28 days–18 years (Class 2b) and thrombectomy for LVO (Class 2a for ≥6 years, Class 2b for younger).

혈전용해 후 수축기혈압을 <140 mmHg로 적극적으로 낮추지 말 것(Class 3, 이득 없음), 혈전제거술 성공 후 72시간 이내에도 적극적 강하 금지(Class 3, 해로움).

keyChanges.detail_ko: 대경색은 이전에 EVT 제외 기준이었다. 신규: 연령 <80, ASPECTS 0–2인 환자에서 6시간 이내 신중한 선별 하에 혈전제거술이 합리적(Class 2a)으로, 광범위 조기 경색에도 이득을 보인 최근 대경색 임상시험을 반영한다.

keyChanges.detail: Previously there was no clear recommendation for basilar/posterior-circulation thrombectomy. New: EVT is Class 1 for basilar artery occlusion within 24 h in patients with baseline mRS 0–1, NIHSS ≥10, and PC-ASPECTS ≥6, based on the ATTENTION and BAOCHE trials.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 이전에는 기저동맥/후순환 혈전제거술에 대한 명확한 권고가 없었다. 신규: 기저동맥 폐색에서 기저 mRS 0–1, NIHSS ≥10, PC-ASPECTS ≥6인 환자에게 24시간 이내 EVT가 Class 1로, ATTENTION 및 BAOCHE 임상시험에 근거한다.

keyChanges.detail: New, more cautious guidance for medium and distal vessel occlusions: thrombectomy is not broadly endorsed because robust randomized evidence is lacking, distinguishing these from proximal LVO indications.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 중간·원위 혈관 폐색에 대해서는 더 신중한 신규 권고: 견고한 무작위 근거가 부족하므로 혈전제거술을 폭넓게 권장하지 않으며, 근위부 LVO 적응증과 구분한다.

keyChanges.detail: New Class 3 (No Benefit): intensive systolic BP lowering to <140 mmHg after IV thrombolysis does NOT improve functional outcomes versus a <180 mmHg target and is not recommended. Pre-treatment target remains <185/110 mmHg.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 신규 Class 3(이득 없음): 정맥 혈전용해 후 수축기혈압을 <140 mmHg로 적극적으로 낮추는 것은 <180 mmHg 목표 대비 기능 예후를 개선하지 못하므로 권장하지 않는다. 치료 전 목표는 여전히 <185/110 mmHg.

keyChanges.detail: New Class 3 (Harm): after successful recanalization, intensive systolic BP reduction to <140 mmHg during the first 72 h is harmful and not recommended, based on ENCHANTED2/MT and OPTIMAL-BP.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 신규 Class 3(해로움): 재관류 성공 후 첫 72시간 동안 수축기혈압을 <140 mmHg로 적극적으로 낮추는 것은 해로우며 권장하지 않는다(ENCHANTED2/MT, OPTIMAL-BP 근거).

keyChanges.detail: New Class 3 (No Benefit): IV insulin targeting tight glucose 80–130 mg/dL does not improve 3-month outcomes and increases hypoglycemia risk (SHINE trial); a target range of 140–180 mg/dL remains reasonable. This moves away from aggressive glucose control.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 신규 Class 3(이득 없음): IV 인슐린으로 80–130 mg/dL의 엄격한 혈당을 목표하는 것은 3개월 예후를 개선하지 못하고 저혈당 위험을 높인다(SHINE 임상시험); 140–180 mg/dL 목표는 여전히 합리적이다. 적극적 혈당 강하에서 벗어난 변화다.

keyChanges.detail: New Class 1 recommendation to use mobile stroke units where feasible to reduce prehospital delays and time to thrombolysis, based on the B_PROUD and BEST-MSU trials.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 신규 Class 1 권고: 가능한 환경에서 병원 전 지연과 혈전용해까지의 시간을 줄이기 위해 이동형 뇌졸중 유닛을 운영한다(B_PROUD, BEST-MSU 근거).

keyChanges.detail: First-ever pediatric AIS recommendations. IV thrombolysis (alteplase) may be considered within 4.5 h for confirmed AIS with disabling deficits, ages 28 days–18 years (Class 2b; safety supported by TIPS). EVT for LVO is Class 2a for ages ≥6 years (6–24 h) and Class 2b for ages 28 days–6 years (within 24 h).
keyChanges.detail_ko: 최초의 소아 AIS 권고. 확진되고 장애를 유발하는 결손이 있는 28일–18세 소아에서 4.5시간 이내 정맥 혈전용해(alteplase) 고려 가능(Class 2b; TIPS로 안전성 근거). LVO 혈전제거술은 ≥6세에서 6–24시간 Class 2a, 28일–6세에서 24시간 이내 Class 2b.

keyChanges.detail: Class 2a: for minor stroke (NIHSS ≤5) or high-risk TIA of presumed atherosclerotic origin, start clopidogrel plus aspirin for 21 days followed by single antiplatelet therapy to reduce recurrent stroke.
keyChanges.detail_ko: Class 2a: 죽상경화 추정 원인의 경증 뇌졸중(NIHSS ≤5) 또는 고위험 TIA에서 clopidogrel과 aspirin을 21일간 병용 후 단일 항혈소판제로 전환하여 재발 뇌졸중을 감소시킨다.

keyChanges.topic: 혈전용해 금기 접근 완화 및 검사 지연 금지
keyChanges.detail: The approach to thrombolysis contraindications was modified/liberalized. New Class 1 emphasis: vascular imaging in suspected LVO should not be delayed to obtain serum creatinine, and baseline ECG/troponin should not delay initiation of IVT or EVT — prioritizing speed to reperfusion.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 혈전용해 금기에 대한 접근이 수정·완화되었다. 신규 Class 1 강조: 의심되는 LVO에서 혈관영상을 혈청 크레아티닌 확인을 위해 지연시키지 말고, 기저 ECG/troponin이 정맥 혈전용해나 혈전제거술 개시를 지연시키지 않도록 한다 — 재관류까지의 속도를 우선한다.

card.practiceImpact: At the bedside, EM/CCM clinicians can now default to tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg as a single IV bolus within 4.5 h — eliminating the alteplase infusion and simplifying door-to-needle workflow — and should use perfusion imaging to extend thrombolysis to 9 h and thrombectomy (including basilar and large-core cases) to 24 h in selected patients. Critically, stop titrating blood pressure below 140 mmHg systolic after thrombolysis or thrombectomy and abandon tight glucose control (80–130 mg/dL), instead accepting a 140–180 mg/dL glucose range and a <180/105 post-lysis BP ceiling, since intensive control adds harm or no benefit. Do not delay CTA/reperfusion waiting on creatinine, ECG, or troponin, and start 21-day clopidogrel-plus-aspirin DAPT for minor stroke/high-risk TIA. Pediatric AIS now has explicit thrombolysis and thrombectomy pathways to follow rather than extrapolation.
card.practiceImpact_ko: 현장에서 응급·중환자 의료진은 이제 4.5시간 이내 tenecteplase 0.25 mg/kg 단회 정맥 볼루스를 기본으로 삼아 alteplase 주입을 없애고 door-to-needle 흐름을 단순화할 수 있으며, 관류영상을 활용해 선별 환자에서 혈전용해를 9시간까지, 혈전제거술(기저동맥·대경색 포함)을 24시간까지 확대해야 한다. 특히 혈전용해나 혈전제거술 후 수축기혈압을 140 mmHg 미만으로 적정하지 말고 엄격한 혈당 조절(80–130 mg/dL)을 중단하여, 대신 혈당 140–180 mg/dL와 용해 후 <180/105 mmHg 상한을 수용한다 — 적극적 조절은 해가 되거나 이득이 없기 때문이다. 크레아티닌·ECG·troponin을 기다리느라 CTA/재관류를 지연시키지 말고, 경증 뇌졸중/고위험 TIA에는 21일 clopidogrel+aspirin DAPT를 시작한다. 소아 AIS도 이제 추정에 의존하지 않고 따를 수 있는 명시적 혈전용해·혈전제거술 경로가 마련되었다.

published.title: Part 1: Executive Summary: 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Emergency Cardiovascular Care.
published.abstract: This executive summary provides an overview of the , which is organized around the Utstein Formula for Survival and provides updated recommendations aimed at improving survival rates and neurological outcomes following cardiac arrest. This executive summary outlines key changes, emphasizing the importance of high-quality chest compressions, early defibrillation, and the integration of advanced resuscitation techniques. These Guidelines also highlight critical post-cardiac arrest care strategies, including targeted temperature management and hemodynamic stabilization. Additionally, they stress the need for population-specific resuscitation approaches, particularly for pediatric patients, pregnant individuals, and individuals with cardiac arrest due to special circumstances. A strong focus is placed on continuous training and education for both medical professionals and lay rescuers to enhance the implementation and effectiveness of these lifesaving interventions. The 2025 Guidelines also highlight the importance of an integrated system of people, protocols, policies, and resources to achieve quality improvement in cardiac arrest care. An overview of ethical considerations relevant to emergency cardiovascular care, resuscitation, and approaches to decision-making surrounding cardiac arrest is also included. By following these updated recommendations, the American Heart Association seeks to optimize resuscitation efforts and improve patient outcomes in cardiac emergencies.

paper.title: Part 1: Executive Summary: 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Emergency Cardiovascular Care.

card.title_ko: 제1부 요약: 2025 미국심장협회(AHA) 심폐소생술 및 응급심혈관치료(CPR·ECC) 가이드라인
card.scope_ko: 모든 연령·모든 장소(병원 내/외)의 심정지 환자를 대상으로 한 심폐소생술 및 응급심혈관치료 종합 지침으로, 성인·소아·신생아 기본소생술(BLS)과 전문소생술(ALS/ACLS·PALS), 제세동, 소생 후 치료, 그리고 임신부·소아·특수상황(아편유사제 중독, 저체온·고체온, 천식, LVAD 등) 등 특수 집단을 포괄한다. 생존을 위한 Utstein 공식(과학·교육·현지 실행)을 축으로 구성되었다.
summary: Prioritize high-quality chest compressions with minimal interruptions and early defibrillation as the foundation of resuscitation across all populations; pauses in compressions should be kept under 10 seconds (esp. pediatrics).

Optimize compression delivery through rescuer hand position, rescuer body position, and patient position; perform CPR on a firm surface, and adjust (rather than remove) a bra and account for body habitus/obesity.
For infant compressions use the two-thumb encircling-hands technique or heel of one hand; the 2-finger technique is no longer recommended.

Epinephrine 1 mg every 3–5 minutes: give as soon as feasible in nonshockable rhythms and after initial defibrillation attempts fail in shockable rhythms; for refractory VF/pVT after ≥3 shocks, vector-change or double-sequential defibrillation MAY be considered but benefit is 'not established.'

Post-cardiac-arrest care uses targeted temperature management with an individualized target in the 32–37.5°C range plus active fever prevention, hemodynamic stabilization, and multimodal neuroprognostication (adding serum neurofilament light chain).
Manual CPR is standard; routine mechanical CPR is not recommended and should be reserved for circumstances where sustained high-quality manual compressions are impractical or unsafe.

Population-specific care is emphasized for pediatric, pregnant, and special-circumstance patients (opioid toxicity with naloxone as an adjunct that must not delay CPR/ventilations, LVAD/VAD, hypothermia/hyperthermia, asthma).

Success depends on an integrated system of people, protocols, policies, and resources with continuous training/education (including for lay rescuers and children ≥12), quality improvement, and attention to ethics and survivor recovery.
summary_ko: 모든 집단에서 소생술의 근간은 중단 최소화된 고품질 흉부압박과 조기 제세동이며, 압박 중단은 10초 미만(특히 소아)으로 유지한다.
구조자의 손 위치·몸 위치, 환자 자세를 최적화하고 단단한 표면에서 압박하며, 브라는 제거가 아니라 조정하고 비만 등 체형을 고려한다.
영아 압박은 양무지 감싸기(two-thumb encircling) 또는 한 손 뒤꿈치 기법을 사용하며, 2-손가락 기법은 더 이상 권고하지 않는다.
Epinephrine 1 mg을 3–5분마다 투여하되, 비제세동 리듬에서는 가능한 한 빨리, 제세동 리듬에서는 초기 제세동 실패 후에 준다; 3회 이상 쇼크 후 불응성 VF/pVT에서 벡터 변경 또는 이중 순차 제세동을 고려할 수 있으나 이득은 '확립되지 않음'.
소생 후 치료는 32–37.5°C 범위의 개별화된 목표를 갖는 목표체온관리(TTM)와 발열 예방, 혈역학 안정화, 그리고 다중모드 신경예후평가(혈청 neurofilament light chain 추가)를 포함한다.
수기(manual) CPR이 표준이며, 상시적 기계식 CPR은 권고하지 않고 고품질 수기 압박 유지가 어렵거나 위험한 상황에 한정한다.
소아·임신부·특수상황 환자에 대한 맞춤 접근을 강조한다(아편유사제 중독 시 naloxone은 보조 수단으로 CPR·환기를 지연시키지 않아야 함, LVAD/VAD, 저체온·고체온, 천식).
성공은 사람·프로토콜·정책·자원의 통합 시스템과 지속적 교육·훈련(일반인 및 12세 이상 아동 포함), 질 개선, 윤리 및 생존자 회복에 대한 관심에 달려 있다.

keyChanges.detail: Previously (2020) there were multiple separate Chains of Survival (adult in-hospital, adult out-of-hospital, pediatric in-hospital, pediatric out-of-hospital). 2025 consolidates these into a single unified Chain of Survival applicable across all ages and settings (adult/pediatric, IHCA/OHCA), with a separate dedicated Newborn Chain of Care introduced for neonates; the high-quality-CPR visual now depicts lungs alongside compressions.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 이전(2020)에는 성인 병원내·성인 병원외·소아 병원내·소아 병원외로 여러 개의 생존사슬이 분리되어 있었다. 2025는 이를 모든 연령·장소에 적용되는 단일 생존사슬로 통합했고, 신생아에는 별도의 Newborn Chain of Care를 도입했다; 고품질 CPR 시각자료에 압박과 함께 폐(환기) 요소가 추가되었다.

keyChanges.detail: 'Rescue breaths' is replaced by 'breaths' (assisted breathing during CPR or for a patient with a pulse but not breathing), while 'ventilation(s)' is reserved for device-/professional-delivered respiratory support; 'bystander' is replaced by 'lay rescuer,' and 'return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC)' is distinguished from 'return of circulation' (which includes mechanical circulatory support).
keyChanges.detail_ko: 'Rescue breaths'를 'breaths'(CPR 중 보조 호흡 또는 맥박은 있으나 호흡이 없는 환자에 대한 호흡)로 바꾸고, 'ventilation(s)'는 기구/전문가에 의한 호흡 보조에 한정한다; 'bystander'는 'lay rescuer'로, 'ROSC(자발순환회복)'는 기계순환보조를 포함하는 'return of circulation'과 구분한다.

keyChanges.detail: The 2-finger infant compression technique is eliminated. 2025 recommends the two-thumb encircling-hands technique or the heel of one hand, because these provide superior compression depth and perfusion quality.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 영아 2-손가락 압박 기법을 폐기한다. 2025는 양무지 감싸기(two-thumb encircling-hands) 또는 한 손 뒤꿈치 기법을 권고하며, 이는 더 나은 압박 깊이와 관류 질을 제공하기 때문이다.

keyChanges.detail: For adults and children, choking relief now starts with 5 back blows and alternates with 5 abdominal thrusts until the object clears or the victim becomes unresponsive. For infants, alternate 5 back blows with 5 chest thrusts (heel of one hand); abdominal thrusts are not used in infants to avoid injury.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 성인·소아의 질식 처치는 이제 등 두드리기 5회로 시작해 복부 밀어내기 5회와 번갈아 시행하며, 이물이 제거되거나 환자가 무반응이 될 때까지 지속한다. 영아는 등 두드리기 5회와 가슴 밀어내기(한 손 뒤꿈치) 5회를 번갈아 하며, 손상 방지를 위해 복부 밀어내기는 사용하지 않는다.

keyChanges.detail: Routine use of mechanical CPR devices is not recommended; manual CPR is reaffirmed as the standard. Mechanical devices should be considered only in specific circumstances where delivering sustained high-quality manual compressions is difficult or unsafe (e.g., transport, limited rescuers, hazardous environments).
keyChanges.detail_ko: 기계식 CPR 장치의 상시적 사용은 권고하지 않으며, 수기 CPR을 표준으로 재확인한다. 기계식 장치는 고품질 수기 압박을 지속하기 어렵거나 위험한 특정 상황(이송, 구조자 부족, 위험 환경 등)에 한해 고려한다.

keyChanges.detail: Pad placement is clarified: anterolateral or anteroposterior are both acceptable. An adult defibrillation electrode diameter of >8 cm is specified. (Part of an equity/quality emphasis, including reducing hesitation to expose/adjust clothing.)
keyChanges.detail_ko: 패드 위치를 명확히 하여 전외측(anterolateral) 또는 전후(anteroposterior) 모두 허용된다. 성인 제세동 전극 지름은 >8 cm로 명시했다. (의복 노출·조정 주저를 줄이는 등 형평성·질 강조의 일환)

keyChanges.topic: 불응성 VF/pVT — 벡터 변경·이중 순차 제세동(DSED)
keyChanges.detail: New addressing of refractory VF/pulseless VT: after ≥3 failed shocks, a pad vector change or double-sequential external defibrillation (DSED) MAY be considered, but the AHA states their usefulness/benefit is 'not established' (evidence limited).
keyChanges.detail_ko: 불응성 VF/무맥성 VT를 새로 다룸: 3회 이상 쇼크 실패 후 패드 벡터 변경 또는 이중 순차 외부 제세동(DSED)을 고려할 수 있으나, AHA는 그 유용성·이득이 '확립되지 않았다'(근거 제한적)고 명시한다.

keyChanges.detail: Epinephrine 1 mg every 3–5 minutes, with timing clarified by rhythm: give as soon as feasible in nonshockable rhythms, and after initial defibrillation attempts have failed in shockable rhythms. For pediatric patients, earlier epinephrine is reasonable for initial nonshockable rhythms.
keyChanges.detail_ko: Epinephrine 1 mg을 3–5분마다 투여하되 리듬에 따라 시점을 명확화: 비제세동 리듬에서는 가능한 한 빨리, 제세동 리듬에서는 초기 제세동 시도 실패 후에 준다. 소아에서는 초기 비제세동 리듬에 대해 조기 epinephrine 투여가 합리적이다.

keyChanges.detail: Moves away from a single fixed 33°C target toward an individualized target temperature in the range of 32–37.5°C with active prevention of fever, reflecting evolving post-arrest temperature-control evidence.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 단일 고정 33°C 목표에서 벗어나 32–37.5°C 범위의 개별화된 목표체온과 능동적 발열 예방으로 이동하며, 이는 변화하는 소생 후 체온관리 근거를 반영한다.

keyChanges.detail: For cardioversion of atrial fibrillation, use an initial biphasic energy of ≥200 J on US-approved platforms (≥200 J achieves >90% cumulative success), rather than starting at lower energies.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 심방세동의 전기적 심율동전환은 미국 승인 이상파형(biphasic) 기기에서 초기 에너지 ≥200 J을 사용한다(≥200 J에서 누적 성공률 >90%), 더 낮은 에너지로 시작하는 대신.

keyChanges.detail: In suspected opioid-associated cardiac arrest, naloxone MAY be reasonable but must not delay chest compressions and ventilations, which remain foundational; expanded public guidance on access to and appropriate use of naloxone/opioid emergency kits is added.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 아편유사제 관련 심정지 의심 시 naloxone 투여가 합리적일 수 있으나 흉부압박과 환기를 지연시켜서는 안 되며, 압박·환기가 근간으로 유지된다; naloxone/아편유사제 응급키트 접근과 적절한 사용에 대한 대중 지침이 확대되었다.

keyChanges.detail: Serum neurofilament light chain is added as a prognostic biomarker within multimodal neuroprognostication; treating myoclonus that has no EEG correlate is not recommended; and new emphasis is placed on assessing/managing survivors' emotional distress and building systems for post-resuscitation recovery.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 다중모드 신경예후평가 내에 혈청 neurofilament light chain을 예후 바이오마커로 추가했다; EEG 상관관계가 없는 근간대경련(myoclonus)의 치료는 권고하지 않는다; 생존자의 정서적 고통 평가·관리와 소생 후 회복 시스템 구축을 새로 강조한다.

keyChanges.detail: For neonates not requiring immediate resuscitation, a ≥60-second delay in cord clamping is recommended (improves hematologic/iron status, reduces mortality). A supraglottic airway is reasonable after failed bag-mask ventilation or at ≥34 weeks gestation, and video laryngoscopy increases neonatal intubation success.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 즉각적 소생이 필요하지 않은 신생아에서 제대결찰을 ≥60초 지연할 것을 권고한다(혈액·철분 상태 개선, 사망률 감소). Bag-mask 환기 실패 후 또는 재태연령 ≥34주에서 성문상기도유지기(supraglottic airway)가 합리적이며, 비디오 후두경이 신생아 기관삽관 성공률을 높인다.

keyChanges.detail: No single ETCO₂ threshold should be used alone to terminate resuscitation in children (survivors have been documented with ETCO₂ <20 mmHg), tempering prior reliance on capnography numbers for stopping efforts.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 소아에서 단일 ETCO₂ 수치만으로 소생술 종료를 결정해서는 안 된다(ETCO₂ <20 mmHg에서도 생존자 보고됨). 소생 중단 결정에서 capnography 수치 의존을 완화한 것이다.

keyChanges.detail: In VAD/LVAD patients with impaired perfusion, initiate chest compressions promptly (begin while simultaneously troubleshooting device connections/power) rather than withholding compressions over device-damage concerns.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 관류가 저하된 VAD/LVAD 환자에서는 장치 손상 우려로 압박을 보류하지 말고 신속히 흉부압박을 시작한다(장치 연결·전원을 동시에 점검하면서 시작).

keyChanges.detail: Reinforces that children ≥12 years can learn and perform effective CPR and use an AED, promotes virtual/augmented-reality training adjuncts, and targets CPR training toward underserved populations to raise bystander response rates.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 12세 이상 아동이 효과적인 CPR을 배우고 시행하며 AED를 사용할 수 있음을 강조하고, 가상/증강현실 훈련 보조를 촉진하며, 목격자 반응률을 높이기 위해 소외 계층에 CPR 교육을 집중한다.

card.practiceImpact: At the bedside, keep manual, minimally-interrupted high-quality compressions on a firm surface as the core, optimize rescuer/patient positioning, and drop the 2-finger infant technique in favor of two-thumb encircling or one-hand heel. Time epinephrine by rhythm (early in nonshockable, post-shock in shockable), reserve vector-change/DSED as a low-evidence option only after ≥3 failed shocks, cardiovert AF starting at ≥200 J, and give naloxone in opioid arrest only if it does not delay CPR. In post-arrest care, target an individualized temperature in the 32–37.5°C band with aggressive fever prevention, and use multimodal prognostication (now including serum neurofilament light chain) while avoiding over-reliance on any single marker such as ETCO₂ or EEG-uncorrelated myoclonus. Systems-level actions — unified Chain of Survival, survivor psychosocial recovery, and targeted community/lay training — should shape your department's protocols and QI.
card.practiceImpact_ko: 침상에서는 단단한 표면 위 중단 최소화 고품질 수기 압박을 근간으로 유지하고, 구조자·환자 자세를 최적화하며, 영아는 2-손가락 대신 양무지 감싸기 또는 한 손 뒤꿈치 기법으로 전환한다. Epinephrine은 리듬에 맞춰(비제세동 리듬 조기, 제세동 리듬 쇼크 후) 투여하고, 벡터 변경·DSED는 3회 이상 쇼크 실패 후에만 근거가 약한 선택지로 남기며, 심방세동 심율동전환은 ≥200 J로 시작하고, 아편유사제 심정지에서 naloxone은 CPR을 지연시키지 않을 때에만 준다. 소생 후에는 32–37.5°C 범위의 개별화된 목표체온과 적극적 발열 예방을 시행하고, 혈청 neurofilament light chain을 포함한 다중모드 예후평가를 사용하되 ETCO₂나 EEG 무상관 myoclonus 같은 단일 지표에 과의존하지 않는다. 통합 생존사슬, 생존자 정서적 회복, 지역사회·일반인 대상 교육 등 시스템 차원의 조치를 부서 프로토콜과 질 개선에 반영해야 한다.

published.title: Part 9: Adult Advanced Life Support: 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Emergency Cardiovascular Care.
published.abstract: In these 2025 Advanced Life Support Guidelines, the American Heart Association provides comprehensive recommendations for the resuscitation and management of adults experiencing cardiac arrest, respiratory arrest, and life-threatening cardiovascular emergencies. Based on structured evidence reviews and the latest clinical research, these guidelines offer evidence-based strategies to optimize survival and patient outcomes. The 2025 guidelines provide guidance for the treatment of cardiac arrest, including ventricular fibrillation, pulseless ventricular tachycardia, asystole, and pulseless electrical activity, as well as peri-arrest conditions such as atrial fibrillation and flutter with rapid ventricular response. Recommendations are made for defibrillation, electrical cardioversion, advanced airway management, drug therapies, and intravenous access. Additionally, guidelines are provided for the use of double sequential defibrillation, head-up cardiopulmonary resuscitation, and point-of-care ultrasound in the advanced life support setting. Termination of resuscitation rules have been refined to guide decision-making based on the emergency medical services professional's scope of practice. Finally, these guidelines also underscore the importance of identifying causative versus secondary arrhythmias to inform the appropriate timing of therapeutic strategies.

card.title_ko: Part 9: 성인 전문소생술(ALS): 심폐소생술 및 응급심혈관치료에 관한 2025 미국심장협회(AHA) 가이드라인
card.scope_ko: 성인의 심정지(심실세동/무맥성 심실빈맥, 무수축, 무맥성 전기활동)와 호흡정지, 그리고 심정지 주변기(peri-arrest) 상태(급속심실반응을 동반한 심방세동·심방조동 등)를 포함한 생명을 위협하는 심혈관 응급의 소생·관리를 다루는 전문소생술(ALS) 임상 가이드라인이다. 제세동·전기적 심율동전환, 전문기도관리, 약물치료, 정맥로 확보, 이중연속제세동·머리거상 CPR·현장초음파(POCUS)의 사용, 소생술 종료 규칙까지 포괄한다.
summary: Prioritize the highest-value actions — uninterrupted high-quality chest compressions and early defibrillation — and sequence airway, access, and drugs around them to minimize pauses.

For vascular access in adult cardiac arrest, attempt IV access first; if IV cannot be rapidly established, use intraosseous (IO) access. Central line placement is not needed during active resuscitation.

Point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) has a limited, supportive role during active resuscitation — use it only to identify reversible causes and only when it does NOT interrupt chest compressions; it is more useful in the post-ROSC period.

The usefulness of double sequential external defibrillation (DSED) and vector-change (VC) defibrillation for refractory VF is addressed but remains not well established; these are not recommended for routine use.

Head-up/elevated CPR and routine mechanical CPR are not recommended for routine use because established benefit is lacking; mechanical CPR may be considered only when high-quality manual CPR is not feasible or safe.

Non-vasopressor drugs (sodium bicarbonate, calcium, magnesium, steroids) are not recommended routinely and should be reserved for specific indications (e.g., hyperkalemia, known hypomagnesemia/torsades, toxicologic arrest).

Termination-of-resuscitation (TOR) rules were refined to match the EMS professional's scope of practice; in-hospital termination is a clinical and ethical judgment to which prehospital TOR rules do not apply.
Emphasize distinguishing a causative (primary) arrhythmia from a secondary arrhythmia to guide the appropriate timing of therapeutic strategies.
summary_ko: 가장 가치가 큰 행위 — 중단 없는 고품질 가슴압박과 조기 제세동 — 을 최우선에 두고, 기도·정맥로·약물은 압박 중단을 최소화하도록 그 주위에 배치·배열한다.
성인 심정지의 혈관로는 정맥로(IV)를 먼저 시도한다. IV를 신속히 확보하지 못하면 골내주사(IO)를 사용한다. 활동적 소생 중 중심정맥관 삽입은 필요하지 않다.
현장초음파(POCUS)는 활동적 소생 중에는 제한적·보조적 역할만 한다 — 가역적 원인 확인 목적에 한정하고 가슴압박을 중단시키지 않을 때만 사용한다. ROSC 이후 시기에 더 유용하다.
불응성 VF에서 이중연속제세동(DSED)과 벡터변경(VC) 제세동의 유용성은 다루어졌으나 아직 확립되지 않았다 — 일상적(routine) 사용은 권고되지 않는다.
머리거상(head-up) CPR과 기계식 CPR의 일상적 사용은 확립된 이득이 없어 권고되지 않는다. 기계식 CPR은 고품질 수기 CPR이 불가능하거나 안전하지 않을 때만 고려할 수 있다.
비승압제 약물(sodium bicarbonate, calcium, magnesium, steroids)은 일상적으로 권고되지 않으며, 특정 적응증(고칼륨혈증, 알려진 저마그네슘혈증/torsades, 중독성 심정지 등)에 한해 사용한다.
소생술 종료(TOR) 규칙은 EMS 종사자의 진료 범위(scope of practice)에 맞추어 정교화되었다. 병원 내 종료는 임상적·윤리적 판단으로, 병원전 TOR 규칙을 그대로 적용하지 않는다.
치료 전략의 적절한 시점을 정하기 위해 원인(1차) 부정맥과 2차성 부정맥을 구분하는 것을 강조한다.

keyChanges.detail: Vascular access was reordered: IV access is now explicitly the first-line route, with IO reserved for when IV cannot be rapidly obtained — a shift from the prior stance that treated IV and IO as effectively equivalent. Central venous line placement is no longer advised during active resuscitation. Stated rationale: avoid delaying epinephrine (especially in non-shockable rhythms) and recent data favoring IV over IO for outcomes.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 혈관로 순서가 재정렬되었다: 이제 IV가 명시적 1차 경로이고, IO는 IV를 신속히 확보하지 못할 때로 미룬다 — IV와 IO를 사실상 동등하게 보던 이전 입장에서 바뀐 것이다. 활동적 소생 중 중심정맥관 삽입은 더 이상 권장되지 않는다. 근거: (특히 비제세동 리듬에서) epinephrine 투여 지연을 막고, IV가 IO보다 예후에서 유리하다는 최근 자료.

keyChanges.detail: New recommendations were added addressing double sequential external defibrillation (DSED) and vector-change (VC) defibrillation for refractory VF, where the 2020 guidelines gave no specific guidance. The 2025 position is that their usefulness is not yet well established and they are not recommended for routine use (weak/uncertain, ~Class IIb where cited).
keyChanges.detail_ko: 불응성 VF에 대한 이중연속제세동(DSED)과 벡터변경(VC) 제세동을 다루는 새 권고가 추가되었다(2020 지침에는 구체적 언급이 없었다). 2025 입장은 유용성이 아직 충분히 확립되지 않았고 일상적 사용은 권고하지 않는다는 것이다(약하거나 불확실 — 인용된 곳에서는 대략 Class IIb).

keyChanges.detail: Sotalol was removed from the recommended antiarrhythmic infusions for stable wide-complex tachycardia; procainamide and amiodarone are the preferred agents. Reason cited: no demonstrated added benefit and slow infusion times.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 안정형 넓은QRS 빈맥에 대해 권고 항부정맥 정주제 목록에서 sotalol이 삭제되었고, procainamide와 amiodarone이 선호 약제로 남았다. 근거: 추가 이득이 입증되지 않았고 주입 시간이 느리다는 점.

keyChanges.detail: Endotracheal (via ETT) drug administration was removed from ACLS because of unreliable absorption; drugs should be given by IV or IO route.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 흡수가 불안정하다는 이유로 기관내(ETT를 통한) 약물투여가 ACLS에서 삭제되었다. 약물은 IV 또는 IO 경로로 투여한다.

keyChanges.detail: POCUS guidance was newly framed: during active resuscitation it is a limited, supportive tool used only to identify reversible causes (tamponade, tension pneumothorax, PE, hypovolemia) and only if it does not interrupt compressions; it is more valuable post-ROSC for cardiac/hemodynamic assessment. Prior guidelines gave little explicit direction on intra-arrest POCUS.
keyChanges.detail_ko: POCUS 지침이 새로 정리되었다: 활동적 소생 중에는 가역적 원인(심장압전, 긴장성 기흉, 폐색전, 저혈량) 확인 목적에만 쓰는 제한적·보조적 도구이며 가슴압박을 중단시키지 않을 때만 사용한다. ROSC 이후 심장기능·혈역학 평가에 더 유용하다. 이전 지침은 심정지 중 POCUS에 대한 명시적 방향이 거의 없었다.

keyChanges.detail: TOR rules were refined so decision-making is keyed to the EMS professional's scope of practice; and it is clarified that in-hospital termination is a separate clinical/ethical judgment (considering rhythm, downtime, interventions, reversible causes, goals of care) to which prehospital TOR rules do not directly apply.
keyChanges.detail_ko: TOR 규칙이 정교화되어, 의사결정이 EMS 종사자의 진료 범위에 맞추어졌다. 또한 병원 내 종료는 (리듬, 심정지 지속시간, 시행한 처치, 가역적 원인, 치료 목표를 고려하는) 별개의 임상적·윤리적 판단이며 병원전 TOR 규칙을 그대로 적용하지 않는다는 점이 분명해졌다.

keyChanges.detail: The guidelines take an explicitly conservative stance: head-up/elevated CPR is not recommended for routine use (benefit not established); routine mechanical CPR is not recommended (reserve for when manual CPR is not feasible/safe); and routine sodium bicarbonate, calcium, magnesium, and steroids are not recommended absent a specific indication.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 지침은 명시적으로 보수적 입장을 취한다: 머리거상 CPR은 일상적 사용을 권고하지 않고(이득 미확립), 기계식 CPR도 일상적으로 권고하지 않으며(수기 CPR이 불가능/비안전할 때로 제한), sodium bicarbonate·calcium·magnesium·steroids도 특정 적응증이 없으면 일상적으로 권고하지 않는다.

keyChanges.topic: 서맥 초기 관리 / 원인 vs 2차성 부정맥
keyChanges.detail: New recommendations were added for the initial management of bradycardia, and the guidelines newly emphasize distinguishing a causative (primary) arrhythmia from a secondary arrhythmia to inform the timing of therapy (e.g., treating the underlying cause versus the rhythm itself).
keyChanges.detail_ko: 서맥 초기 관리에 대한 새 권고가 추가되었고, 치료 시점을 정하기 위해 원인(1차) 부정맥과 2차성 부정맥을 구분하는 것(예: 리듬 자체가 아니라 기저 원인을 치료)을 새롭게 강조한다.

card.practiceImpact: At the bedside, default to IV-first for drug delivery and stop reaching for central lines or the ETT to give arrest drugs; keep IO in reserve for failed/slow IV. Resist the temptation to routinely deploy head-up CPR, mechanical CPR, DSED/vector change, or ampules of bicarb/calcium/mag — reserve them for specific indications, and never let POCUS or airway maneuvers interrupt compressions. Drop sotalol from your stable wide-complex tachycardia toolkit in favor of procainamide/amiodarone. For EMS and ED leadership, revisit termination-of-resuscitation protocols so they map to each provider's scope of practice, and treat in-hospital TOR as a distinct clinical/ethical decision.
card.practiceImpact_ko: 현장에서는 약물 투여를 IV 우선으로 기본값을 잡고, 심정지 약물을 위해 중심정맥관이나 ETT로 손을 뻗지 않는다. IO는 IV 실패/지연 시 예비로 둔다. 머리거상 CPR·기계식 CPR·DSED/벡터변경·bicarb/calcium/magnesium 앰플을 일상적으로 꺼내려는 유혹을 억제하고 특정 적응증에만 사용하며, POCUS나 기도 조작이 가슴압박을 중단시키지 않게 한다. 안정형 넓은QRS 빈맥에서 sotalol을 빼고 procainamide/amiodarone을 쓴다. EMS·응급실 리더는 TOR 프로토콜을 각 제공자의 진료 범위에 맞게 재정비하고, 병원 내 TOR는 별개의 임상적·윤리적 판단으로 다룬다.

published.title: Society of Critical Care Medicine Guidelines for the Administration of Neuromuscular Blockade in Adults With Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome.
published.abstract:
RATIONALE: Neuromuscular blocking agents (NMBAs) show potential benefits on mortality and other complications of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) in adult patients. Evidence-based decisions and processes ensure appropriate use of neuromuscular blockade in adult patients with ARDS.
OBJECTIVES: The objective of these guidelines was to develop evidence-based recommendations for the administration of NMBAs in critically ill adult patients with ARDS.
DESIGN: The American College of Critical Care Medicine Board convened a 21-member multidisciplinary panel of experts in critical care medicine, nursing, respiratory therapy, pharmacology, surgery, neurology, and anesthesiology. The panel included two expert methodologists specialized in developing evidence-based recommendations in alignment with the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) methodology. Conflict-of-interest policies were strictly followed during all phases of guidelines development including task force selection and voting.
METHODS: The panel members identified and formulated five Population, Intervention, Comparison, and Outcome questions. We conducted a systematic review for each question to identify the best available evidence, statistically analyzed the evidence, and assessed the certainty of the evidence using the GRADE methodology. We used the GRADE evidence-to-decision framework to formulate the recommendations.
RESULTS: The panel generated two conditional recommendations. One recommendation is to use NMBAs in adults with ARDS with Pao2/Fio2 less than 150. For the other recommendations, there was equipoise in the recommendation for and against using titratable vs. fixed-dose NMBA dosing, a monitoring-based strategy for assessing depth of sedation and analgesia in adults with ARDS before initiating or while receiving neuromuscular blockade, and administration of NMBAs for patients who are proned, due to overall lack of evidence in critically ill patients and due to considerations of patient safety and experience concerns.
CONCLUSIONS: These guidelines provide additional perspectives on the use of NMBA in patients with ARDS, recognizing that institutional and patient-specific considerations must help to guide the decision-making process.

paper.title: Society of Critical Care Medicine Guidelines for the Administration of Neuromuscular Blockade in Adults With Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome.

card.org: SCCM (Society of Critical Care Medicine / American College of Critical Care Medicine)
card.title_ko: 성인 급성호흡곤란증후군(ARDS) 환자에서 신경근차단제 투여에 관한 SCCM 진료지침 (2026)
card.scope_ko: 급성호흡곤란증후군(ARDS)을 가진 성인 중환자에서 신경근차단제(NMBA) 사용에 관한 근거기반 권고를 다룬다. 사용 여부(적응증), 용량 전략(고정용량 vs 적정용량), 진정·진통 깊이 평가·모니터링, 그리고 복와위(prone) 환자에서의 NMBA 투여라는 다섯 개의 PICO 질문을 GRADE 방법으로 다룬다. 소아·비-ARDS 중환자는 대상이 아니다.
summary: Recommendation 1 — Indication: Suggest using NMBAs over not using NMBAs in adults with ARDS and PaO2/FiO2 <150 who are persistently hypoxemic and/or not achieving mechanical ventilation targets on sedation (conditional recommendation, LOW certainty of evidence).

Recommendation 2 — Dosing strategy: Suggest EITHER a fixed-dose strategy without monitoring depth of neuromuscular blockade OR a titration-based strategy with monitoring of depth of blockade (conditional, VERY LOW certainty) — genuine equipoise, either is acceptable.

Recommendation 3 — Pre-initiation assessment: Suggest EITHER a scale-based OR a nonscale-based evaluation of depth of analgesia and sedation before initiating NMBA in adults with ARDS (conditional, VERY LOW certainty).

Recommendation 4 — Ongoing monitoring: Suggest EITHER a monitoring-based strategy OR no monitoring of depth of analgesia and sedation in adults with ARDS while receiving NMBAs (conditional, VERY LOW certainty).

Recommendation 5 — Prone positioning: Suggest EITHER administering OR not administering neuromuscular blockade in adult patients who are proned for ARDS (conditional, VERY LOW certainty) — no evidence favors routine NMBA solely to enable proning.

Overall: Only one of the five recommendations (the PaO2/FiO2 <150 indication) gives net direction; the other four express true equipoise because of a lack of evidence in critically ill patients plus patient-safety/experience considerations. All decisions must be individualized to institutional and patient-specific context.
summary_ko: 권고 1 — 적응증: PaO2/FiO2 <150이면서 진정에도 지속적 저산소혈증이거나 인공호흡 목표를 달성하지 못하는 성인 ARDS 환자에서 NMBA를 사용하지 않는 것보다 사용할 것을 제안한다(조건부 권고, 근거수준 LOW).
권고 2 — 용량 전략: 차단 깊이를 모니터링하지 않는 고정용량 전략 또는 차단 깊이를 모니터링하는 적정용량 전략 중 어느 쪽이든 제안한다(조건부, VERY LOW) — 실질적 equipoise로 둘 다 허용.
권고 3 — 개시 전 평가: NMBA 개시 전 진정·진통 깊이를 척도기반(scale-based) 또는 비-척도기반(nonscale-based) 중 어느 방법으로든 평가할 것을 제안한다(조건부, VERY LOW).
권고 4 — 유지 중 모니터링: NMBA를 투여 중인 성인 ARDS 환자에서 진정·진통 깊이를 모니터링하는 전략 또는 모니터링하지 않는 전략 중 어느 쪽이든 제안한다(조건부, VERY LOW).
권고 5 — 복와위: 복와위를 시행하는 성인 ARDS 환자에서 NMBA를 투여하거나 투여하지 않는 것 중 어느 쪽이든 제안한다(조건부, VERY LOW) — 복와위를 위한 상시 NMBA 사용을 지지하는 근거는 없다.
종합: 다섯 권고 중 방향성을 주는 것은 PaO2/FiO2 <150 적응증 하나뿐이며, 나머지 넷은 중환자 대상 근거 부족과 환자 안전·경험 고려로 인해 진정한 equipoise를 표명한다. 모든 결정은 기관·환자별 상황에 맞춰 개별화해야 한다.

keyChanges.detail: The prior SCCM/ACCM document was the 2016 'Clinical Practice Guidelines for Sustained Neuromuscular Blockade in the Adult Critically Ill Patient' — a broad guideline covering all critically ill adults (indications across shivering/therapeutic hypothermia, drug selection, TOF monitoring, complications). The 2026 document is a dedicated, ARDS-specific guideline built around five focused PICO questions on NMBAs in ARDS only, rather than a general critical-illness scope.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 이전 SCCM/ACCM 문서는 2016년 '성인 중환자에서 지속적 신경근차단 진료지침'으로, 모든 중환자를 폭넓게 다뤘다(오한/치료적 저체온, 약물 선택, TOF 모니터링, 합병증 등). 2026년 문서는 ARDS만을 대상으로 다섯 개의 초점화된 PICO 질문(NMBA in ARDS)에 집중한 ARDS 특화 지침으로, 일반 중환자 범위에서 ARDS 전용 범위로 좁혀졌다.

keyChanges.detail: For the ARDS indication the PaO2/FiO2 <150 threshold is retained, but the 2026 recommendation is graded conditional with LOW certainty of evidence and adds an explicit clinical qualifier — NMBA is suggested for patients who are 'persistently hypoxemic and/or not achieving mechanical ventilation targets on sedation' — reflecting the negative/neutral ROSE (2019) trial that tempered the earlier ACURASYS-driven enthusiasm. This is a more cautious, targeted framing than a blanket early-severe-ARDS recommendation.
keyChanges.detail_ko: ARDS 적응증에서 PaO2/FiO2 <150 기준은 유지되었으나, 2026 권고는 조건부·근거수준 LOW로 등급화되고 명시적 임상 단서를 추가했다 — '진정에도 지속적으로 저산소혈증이거나 인공호흡 목표를 달성하지 못하는' 환자에 한해 NMBA를 제안한다. 이는 초기 ACURASYS 기반의 적극적 권고를 완화시킨 중립/음성 결과의 ROSE(2019) 시험을 반영한 것으로, 초기·중증 ARDS 전반에 대한 일괄 권고보다 더 신중하고 표적화된 문구다.

keyChanges.detail: Rather than prescribing a single approach, the 2026 guideline explicitly declares equipoise on three operational questions — fixed-dose vs titratable dosing, scale-based vs nonscale-based sedation/analgesia assessment before initiation, and monitoring vs no monitoring during NMB — plus prone-positioning NMBA use, all at VERY LOW certainty. The practical change is that clinicians are told either option is acceptable rather than being directed to a specific monitoring/dosing standard.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 2026 지침은 단일 방법을 규정하는 대신 세 가지 운영 질문 — 고정용량 vs 적정용량, 개시 전 척도기반 vs 비-척도기반 진정·진통 평가, 유지 중 모니터링 vs 비모니터링 — 과 복와위 NMBA 사용에 대해 모두 VERY LOW 근거로 equipoise를 명시한다. 실무적 변화는 특정 모니터링/용량 표준으로 지시하기보다 어느 선택이든 허용된다고 안내한다는 점이다.

augmentedSections.body_ko: SCCM은 본 지침과 함께, 성인 ARDS 환자에 대한 NMBA 투여에 관여하는 병원 관리자·다직종 임상진을 돕기 위한 이행 툴킷(implementation toolkit)을 별도로 발간했다. 이는 지침의 권고 자체가 아니라, 권고를 실제 병동 프로토콜로 옮기는 것을 지원하는 SCCM 공식 부속 자료다.
augmentedSections.sourceLabel: SCCM 공식 지침 페이지 (Guidelines for the Administration of Neuromuscular Blockade in Adults With ARDS)

card.practiceImpact: At the bedside, reserve continuous NMBA for adults with ARDS and PaO2/FiO2 <150 who remain hypoxemic or are fighting the ventilator despite adequate sedation — do not use NMBA reflexively in all moderate-to-severe ARDS. Because dosing (fixed vs titrated), depth-of-block/TOF monitoring, and sedation-depth monitoring are all rated equipoise, EM/CCM teams can standardize to their institutional protocol and resources rather than mandating quantitative monitoring, but must guarantee deep analgesia/sedation is in place before and during paralysis. NMBA is not endorsed as a routine adjunct simply to facilitate proning — decide case by case. Given the low/very-low certainty throughout, keep courses time-limited, reassess daily, and individualize.
card.practiceImpact_ko: 침상에서는 지속적 NMBA를 PaO2/FiO2 <150이면서 충분한 진정에도 저산소혈증이 지속되거나 인공호흡기와 싸우는 성인 ARDS 환자에 한정한다 — 중등도~중증 ARDS 전반에 반사적으로 쓰지 않는다. 용량(고정 vs 적정), 차단 깊이/TOF 모니터링, 진정 깊이 모니터링이 모두 equipoise로 평가되므로, EM/CCM 팀은 정량 모니터링을 의무화하기보다 기관 프로토콜·자원에 맞춰 표준화할 수 있으나 마비 전·중 깊은 진통·진정이 확보되었음은 반드시 보장해야 한다. NMBA는 단지 복와위를 돕기 위한 상시 보조수단으로 권장되지 않으므로 사례별로 결정한다. 전반적으로 근거수준이 낮으므로 투여기간을 제한하고 매일 재평가하며 개별화한다.

published.title: [Update ERC guidelines 2025 on cardiopulmonary resuscitation].
published.abstract: In October 2025 the current resuscitation guidelines of the European Resuscitation Council (ERC) were published in Resuscitation and translated into the German language by the German Resuscitation Council (GRC). This article focuses specifically on the main aspects and changes to the recommendations on basic life support, adult advanced life support and postresuscitation care. It should be emphasized that dispatchers will be involved earlier than before in the process of cardiopulmonary resuscitation in the form of assisted telephone resuscitation. Furthermore, in the event of persistent ventricular fibrillation, a so-called vector change should be considered. Probably the biggest change is that the previous targeted temperature management is no longer recommended and that only temperature control should be attempted.

paper.title: [Update ERC guidelines 2025 on cardiopulmonary resuscitation].

card.org: European Resuscitation Council (ERC); translated by German Resuscitation Council (GRC)
card.title_ko: 심폐소생술에 관한 ERC 가이드라인 2025 개정
card.scope_ko: 성인 심정지 환자를 대상으로 한 유럽소생협의회(ERC) 2025 소생술 지침의 개정 내용을 다루며, 특히 기본소생술(BLS), 성인 전문소생술(ALS), 소생 후 치료(post-resuscitation care)의 주요 변경점에 초점을 둔다. 2025년 10월 Resuscitation에 발표되었고 GRC가 독일어로 번역하였다.
summary: In basic life support, emergency medical dispatchers should be involved earlier and more actively through assisted (dispatcher-guided) telephone CPR — helping the caller recognise cardiac arrest and agonal/abnormal breathing and coaching chest compressions.

In adult advanced life support, for refractory/persistent ventricular fibrillation (VF continuing after three consecutive shocks with correct antero-lateral pad placement), a defibrillation vector change to an alternative pad position (e.g. antero-posterior) should be considered.
Routine dual (double) sequential defibrillation (DSD) is NOT recommended, given practical challenges with two defibrillators and limited evidence of efficacy.
Drug dosing in ALS is retained: adrenaline 1 mg IV every 3–5 min while ALS continues; amiodarone 300 mg IV after the 3rd shock and a further 150 mg IV after the 5th shock in VF/pVT.

In post-resuscitation care, the previous targeted temperature management is no longer recommended — only 'temperature control' should be attempted, meaning active fever prevention with a target ≤37.5 °C for ≥72 h in patients who remain comatose after ROSC.
Oxygenation: give 100% oxygen initially, then titrate to SpO₂ 94–98%, with a new caution about pulse-oximetry inaccuracy in patients with darker skin tones; ventilation targets normocapnia.
Haemodynamics: target a mean arterial pressure (MAP) >60–65 mmHg after ROSC.
The Chain of Survival was redesigned to emphasise prevention (moved to the header of the first ring) and to add survivorship/long-term recovery, reflecting a continuum from arrest to recovery.
summary_ko: 기본소생술에서 응급의료 상황실 요원(dispatcher)이 이전보다 더 일찍·적극적으로 개입해야 하며, 전화 유도 심폐소생술(assisted telephone CPR)로 신고자가 심정지와 비정상/헐떡호흡을 인지하도록 돕고 가슴압박을 코치한다.
성인 전문소생술에서 불응성/지속성 심실세동(정확한 antero-lateral 패드 위치로 3회 연속 제세동 후에도 지속되는 VF)의 경우, 대체 패드 위치(예: antero-posterior)로 제세동 벡터 변경(vector change)을 고려해야 한다.
이중 순차 제세동(DSD)의 통상적 사용은 권고하지 않는다 — 제세동기 2대 사용의 실무적 어려움과 효능 근거 부족 때문이다.
ALS 약물 용량은 유지: adrenaline 1 mg IV를 ALS 지속 중 3–5분마다; VF/pVT에서 3회 쇼크 후 amiodarone 300 mg IV, 5회 쇼크 후 추가 150 mg IV.
소생 후 치료에서 기존의 목표체온유지(targeted temperature management)는 더 이상 권고되지 않고 '체온 조절(temperature control)'만 시도한다 — ROSC 후 혼수 환자에서 ≤37.5 °C를 ≥72시간 유지하는 능동적 발열 예방을 의미한다.
산소화: 초기에는 100% 산소를 투여하고 이후 SpO₂ 94–98%로 적정하며, 피부색이 어두운 환자에서 맥박산소측정 오차에 대한 새로운 주의를 담았다; 환기는 정상탄산혈증(normocapnia)을 목표로 한다.
혈역학: ROSC 후 평균동맥압(MAP) >60–65 mmHg를 목표로 한다.
생존 사슬(Chain of Survival)이 재설계되어 예방(첫 고리 상단으로 이동)을 강조하고 생존자 지원·장기 회복을 추가하여 '심정지에서 회복까지'의 연속선을 반영한다.

keyChanges.detail: Previous targeted temperature management (TTM, i.e. actively targeting a defined temperature such as 32–36 °C) is NO LONGER recommended. New recommendation: only 'temperature control' — active fever prevention targeting ≤37.5 °C for ≥72 h in patients remaining comatose after ROSC. Reason: evidence (notably the TTM2 trial and subsequent evidence review) did not show benefit of active hypothermia over active fever prevention, so the guidance shifts from inducing/targeting a set temperature to simply preventing fever.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 기존의 목표체온유지(TTM, 즉 32–36 °C 같은 특정 목표체온을 능동적으로 맞추던 방식)는 더 이상 권고되지 않는다. 새 권고: ROSC 후 혼수 상태가 지속되는 환자에서 ≤37.5 °C를 ≥72시간 유지하는 능동적 발열 예방, 즉 '체온 조절(temperature control)'만 시도한다. 이유: 근거(특히 TTM2 시험 및 이후 근거 검토)에서 능동적 저체온이 능동적 발열 예방보다 이득이 있다고 보이지 않았기 때문에, 특정 목표체온을 유도·설정하던 방식에서 발열만 예방하는 방향으로 전환되었다.

keyChanges.detail: Dispatchers are involved earlier and more actively than before through assisted (dispatcher-guided) telephone CPR: the dispatch centre now explicitly helps the caller identify cardiac arrest and abnormal/agonal breathing (ventilation failure) and coaches bystander compressions. This strengthens the emphasis on the critical first 3–5 minutes after arrest.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 상황실 요원이 이전보다 더 일찍·적극적으로 전화 유도 심폐소생술(assisted telephone CPR)에 개입한다: 상황실이 신고자가 심정지와 비정상/헐떡호흡(환기 실패)을 인지하도록 명시적으로 돕고 목격자 가슴압박을 코치한다. 이는 심정지 후 결정적인 첫 3–5분의 중요성 강조를 강화한다.

keyChanges.detail: For refractory/persistent VF — defined as continuous VF after three consecutive shocks with confirmed correct antero-lateral pad position — consider a defibrillation vector change by moving to an alternative pad position (e.g. antero-posterior); prepare a fresh set of pads at the next rhythm check and optimise transthoracic impedance (e.g. shaving the pad areas). This is a newly emphasised option; routine dual (double) sequential defibrillation is explicitly NOT recommended due to practical challenges and limited efficacy evidence.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 불응성/지속성 VF — antero-lateral 패드 위치가 정확함을 확인한 상태에서 3회 연속 제세동 후에도 지속되는 VF로 정의 — 의 경우, 대체 패드 위치(예: antero-posterior)로 옮기는 제세동 벡터 변경을 고려한다; 다음 리듬 확인 시 새 패드 세트를 준비하고 흉부 임피던스를 최적화한다(예: 패드 부위 제모). 이는 새롭게 강조된 선택지이며, 이중 순차 제세동(DSD)의 통상적 사용은 실무적 어려움과 효능 근거 부족으로 명시적으로 권고하지 않는다.

keyChanges.detail: The four-ring Chain of Survival was revised: 'prevention of cardiac arrest' was moved to the header of the first ring to emphasise its growing importance, and the chain now explicitly incorporates survivorship and long-term recovery (from 'arrest to recovery'), including rehabilitation, structured follow-up and psychological support for both survivors and rescuers.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 4개 고리의 생존 사슬이 개정되었다: '심정지 예방'이 그 중요성 증대를 강조하기 위해 첫 고리의 상단(header)으로 이동했고, 사슬은 이제 생존자 지원과 장기 회복('심정지에서 회복까지')을 명시적으로 포함하여 재활, 체계적 추적관찰, 생존자와 구조자 모두를 위한 심리적 지원을 담는다.

keyChanges.detail: Post-resuscitation targets clarified: oxygen 100% initially then titrate to SpO₂ 94–98% (new caution on pulse-oximetry inaccuracy in darker skin tones); target normocapnia (with a caution about hypocapnia risk during hypothermia); maintain MAP >60–65 mmHg; multimodal neuroprognostication is applied to all comatose/unconscious patients (e.g. motor GCS ≤5), with specified timing for imaging and SSEP.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 소생 후 목표가 명확화됨: 산소는 초기 100% 후 SpO₂ 94–98%로 적정(어두운 피부색에서 맥박산소측정 오차에 대한 새 주의); 정상탄산혈증(normocapnia) 목표(저체온 중 저탄산혈증 위험 주의); MAP >60–65 mmHg 유지; 다중양식 신경예후평가를 모든 혼수/의식저하 환자(예: 운동 GCS ≤5)에 적용하며 영상검사와 SSEP의 시행 시점을 명시한다.

augmentedSections.body_ko: European Heart Journal: Acute Cardiovascular Care의 논평 'From arrest to recovery: the 2025 ERC guidelines redefine the chain of survival'는 2025 ERC 지침이 생존 사슬을 즉각적 생존만이 아니라 의미 있는 회복과 삶의 질까지 포괄하는 연속선으로 재개념화했다고 평가한다. 예방·조기 인지(지역사회 심혈관 위험 감소, 유전성 심질환 가족 선별), 목격자 행동('Three Steps to Save a Life' — Check-Call-CPR/AED, 상황실 유도 소생, 구조자 심리 지원), 전문 치료(신속 제세동·구조화된 팀 소통·표적 생리학적 개입), 소생 후·장기 회복(다중양식 신경보호, 체온 관리, 재활, 구조화된 추적관찰과 공동생존자 지원)의 네 단계를 강조한다고 소개한다. (주의: 이는 지침 원문이 아니라 저널 논평의 해석이다.)

card.practiceImpact: At the bedside, stop actively cooling comatose post-arrest patients to 32–36 °C — instead run continuous temperature control aimed only at preventing fever (keep core ≤37.5 °C for at least 72 h), while still avoiding hyperthermia aggressively. In refractory VF after three shocks, quickly switch pad vector (e.g. antero-lateral → antero-posterior) rather than reaching for routine double sequential defibrillation, and keep standard adrenaline 1 mg q3–5 min and amiodarone 300 mg/150 mg dosing. EMS and dispatch systems should reinforce dispatcher-guided telephone CPR and recognition of agonal breathing, and post-ROSC care should target SpO₂ 94–98%, normocapnia, and MAP >60–65 mmHg with structured neuroprognostication and recovery/rehabilitation follow-up.
card.practiceImpact_ko: 임상 현장에서 혼수 상태의 심정지 후 환자를 32–36 °C로 능동적으로 냉각하던 관행을 중단하고, 대신 발열 예방만을 목표로 하는 지속적 체온 조절(중심체온 ≤37.5 °C를 최소 72시간 유지)을 시행하되 고체온은 여전히 적극적으로 피한다. 3회 쇼크 후 불응성 VF에서는 통상적 이중 순차 제세동에 손대기보다 패드 벡터를 신속히 변경(예: antero-lateral → antero-posterior)하고, adrenaline 1 mg 3–5분마다·amiodarone 300 mg/150 mg의 표준 용량은 유지한다. 응급의료·상황실 체계는 상황실 유도 전화 CPR과 헐떡호흡 인지를 강화해야 하며, ROSC 후 치료는 SpO₂ 94–98%, 정상탄산혈증, MAP >60–65 mmHg를 목표로 하고 체계적 신경예후평가와 회복·재활 추적관찰을 포함해야 한다.

published.title: 2025 Korean Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation: Part 6. Post-cardiac arrest care.
published.abstract: This guideline summarizes evidence-based post-cardiac arrest care following the return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC) in adults, incorporating updates from the 2025 Korean Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and contemporary international evidence. Recommendations were informed by recent randomized controlled trials and systematic reviews, with an emphasis on patient-centered outcomes and practical clinical applications. After ROSC, early evaluation should focus on identifying reversible causes. A 12-lead electrocardiogram should be obtained promptly, with echocardiography and whole-body computed tomography performed when clinically indicated to assess cardiac function and detect noncardiac or occult etiologies. Respiratory management aims to minimize secondary brain injury by preventing hypoxemia and hyperoxemia. High inspired oxygen concentrations may be used initially, followed by titration to an appropriate oxygen saturation level once reliable measurements are available, and ventilation should target normocapnia. Hemodynamic management prioritizes adequate organ perfusion and prompt treatment of shock, including active correction of hypotension. Routine immediate coronary angiography is not recommended in patients without ST-segment elevation. However, urgent angiography is indicated in those with ST-segment elevation, cardiogenic shock, or a high likelihood of ongoing myocardial ischemia. In comatose survivors, temperature control is essential. The selected target temperature should be maintained for at least 24 hours, with active fever prevention for 36 to 72 hours. Additional intensive care unit management includes glucose control and seizure monitoring. Routine prophylactic antibiotics or anticonvulsants are not recommended. Neuroprognostication should use a multimodal approach after confounders, such as sedation and temperature management, are addressed, integrating clinical examination, electrophysiology, biomarkers, and neuroimaging to support individualized decision-making.

card.scope_ko: 자발순환회복(ROSC) 이후 성인 심정지 생존자의 소생 후 통합 치료를 다루는 임상진료지침입니다. 원인 감별을 위한 초기 평가·영상, 산소/환기 목표, 혈역학 관리, 관상동맥조영술 적응증, 목표체온관리(TTM)와 발열 예방, 혈당·경련·감염 관리, 그리고 혼수 생존자의 신경학적 예후 예측(다중모드)까지 포괄합니다. 소아·외상성 심정지 특수상황은 별도 파트에서 다룹니다.
summary: Perform a 12-lead ECG promptly in all adults with ROSC (strong recommendation, moderate certainty); whole-body CT and echocardiography may be considered when clinically indicated to find reversible/occult causes (weak, low certainty).

Avoid hypoxemia (strong, moderate); give 100% O2 until reliable SpO2/PaO2 is available (prehospital strong/moderate, in-hospital strong/low), then titrate FiO2 to SaO2 94–98% (weak, low). Target normocapnia PaCO2 35–45 mmHg (strong, moderate).
Maintain MAP ≥60–65 mmHg in both OHCA and IHCA survivors and actively correct hypotension/shock (strong recommendation, moderate certainty).
Do NOT perform routine early coronary angiography in comatose patients without ST-elevation (weak, low); perform emergency angiography for ST-elevation or cardiogenic shock (strong, low).

Provide targeted temperature management in comatose ROSC patients with a target 33–37.5 °C (strong, moderate), maintained ≥24 h (weak, moderate); 33 °C may be considered for OHCA with initial nonshockable rhythm (weak, low). Actively prevent fever for 36–72 h (expert consensus).

Target blood glucose 144–180 mg/dL (weak, moderate) and immediately correct hypoglycemia (strong, moderate); do NOT give prophylactic antiepileptics (weak, very low), antibiotics (weak, moderate), or steroids (weak, low) routinely — treat seizures only when clinically/electrographically evident.

Do NOT routinely infuse large-volume cold IV fluids for prehospital cooling (strong, moderate); do not actively rewarm comatose patients who are spontaneously hypothermic after ROSC (good practice statement).

Prognosticate poor outcome only with a multimodal approach after removing confounders (sedation, temperature), combining exam (absent pupillary/corneal reflex ≥72 h, quantitative pupillometry), electrophysiology (absent N20 SSEP ≥24 h, highly malignant/suppression EEG), biomarkers (NSE), and neuroimaging (low GWR on CT, DWI/ADC on MRI) — all weak, very-low-to-low certainty.
summary_ko: 모든 ROSC 성인에서 12-lead ECG를 신속히 시행한다(강한 권고, 중등도 확실성). 가역적·잠복 원인 감별을 위해 임상적으로 필요하면 전신 CT와 심초음파를 고려할 수 있다(약한 권고, 낮은 확실성).
저산소혈증을 피한다(강한 권고, 중등도). 신뢰할 SpO2/PaO2가 확보될 때까지 100% 산소를 투여하고(병원전 강한/중등도, 병원내 강한/낮음), 이후 FiO2를 적정해 SaO2 94–98%를 유지한다(약한, 낮음). PaCO2는 정상범위 35–45 mmHg를 목표로 한다(강한, 중등도).
OHCA·IHCA 생존자 모두 MAP ≥60–65 mmHg를 유지하고 저혈압·쇼크를 적극 교정한다(강한 권고, 중등도 확실성).
ST 상승이 없는 혼수 환자에서 관상동맥조영술을 일상적으로 조기 시행하지 않는다(약한, 낮음). ST 상승 또는 심인성 쇼크가 있으면 응급 조영술을 시행한다(강한, 낮음).
혼수 ROSC 환자에게 목표체온관리를 시행하며 목표온도는 33–37.5 °C(강한, 중등도), 선택한 목표온도를 최소 24시간 유지한다(약한, 중등도). 초기 비제세동리듬 OHCA에서는 33 °C를 고려할 수 있다(약한, 낮음). 이후 36–72시간 동안 발열을 적극 예방한다(전문가 합의).
혈당은 144–180 mg/dL를 목표로 하고(약한, 중등도) 저혈당은 즉시 교정한다(강한, 중등도). 예방적 항경련제(약한, 매우 낮음)·항생제(약한, 중등도)·스테로이드(약한, 낮음)는 일상적으로 투여하지 않으며, 경련은 임상적·뇌파상 확인될 때만 치료한다.
병원전 냉각을 위한 대량 차가운 정맥수액의 일상적 주입은 권고하지 않는다(강한, 중등도). ROSC 후 자발적으로 저체온인 혼수 환자를 적극적으로 재가온하지 않는다(good practice statement).
불량 예후 예측은 진정·체온 등 교란요인을 제거한 뒤 다중모드로만 시행한다 — 신경학적 검사(≥72h 동공/각막반사 소실, 정량적 동공측정), 전기생리(≥24h N20 SSEP 소실, highly malignant/억제 EEG), 바이오마커(NSE), 신경영상(CT GWR 저하, MRI DWI/ADC)을 통합한다(모두 약한, 매우 낮음~낮음 확실성).

keyChanges.detail: The recommended target temperature range was revised from 32–36 °C (2020) to 33–37.5 °C (2025) for comatose ROSC patients (strong recommendation, moderate certainty). Rationale: 32 °C is rarely used in Korean clinical practice (Korean Hypothermia Therapy Society data), and ILCOR systematic reviews found no differences in survival or neurological outcome across temperature targets, so the guideline widened the range upward to include active normothermia/fever control rather than mandating deep hypothermia.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 혼수 ROSC 환자의 목표온도 범위가 2020년 32–36 °C에서 2025년 33–37.5 °C로 개정되었습니다(강한 권고, 중등도 확실성). 근거: 한국 임상에서 32 °C는 거의 쓰이지 않고(대한저체온치료학회 자료), ILCOR 체계적 고찰에서 목표온도별 생존·신경학적 예후 차이가 없어, 깊은 저체온을 강제하기보다 적극적 정상체온/발열관리를 포함하도록 범위를 상향 조정했습니다.

keyChanges.detail: The 2025 guideline explicitly specifies active fever prevention for 36–72 hours after ROSC in patients who remain comatose (expert consensus), whereas the 2020 version did not specify a duration. Basis: an RCT of 789 patients found no difference in 90-day survival or favorable neurological outcome between 36- and 72-hour fever-control protocols.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 2025 지침은 혼수 지속 환자에서 ROSC 후 36–72시간 동안 적극적 발열 예방을 명시했습니다(전문가 합의). 2020년에는 기간이 명시되지 않았습니다. 근거: 789명 RCT에서 36시간과 72시간 발열관리 사이에 90일 생존·양호 신경학적 예후 차이가 없었습니다.

keyChanges.detail: Routine immediate/early coronary angiography — previously applied more broadly — is now NOT recommended in comatose patients without ST-elevation (weak, low); emergency angiography is reserved for ST-elevation or cardiogenic shock (strong, low). A delayed approach after stabilization/neurologic recovery may be considered. Basis: five RCTs (COACT, DISCO, PEARL, TOMAHAWK, EMERGE) showed immediate angiography did not improve short- or mid-to-long-term outcomes in non-STEMI ROSC patients.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 이전에 더 폭넓게 적용되던 즉시/조기 관상동맥조영술이, 이제 ST 상승이 없는 혼수 환자에서는 권고되지 않습니다(약한, 낮음). 응급 조영술은 ST 상승 또는 심인성 쇼크로 한정하며, 안정화·신경학적 회복 후 지연 시행을 고려할 수 있습니다. 근거: 5개 RCT(COACT, DISCO, PEARL, TOMAHAWK, EMERGE)에서 비-STEMI ROSC 환자에게 즉시 조영술이 단기·중장기 예후를 개선하지 못했습니다.

keyChanges.detail: The hemodynamic target was standardized to MAP ≥60–65 mmHg for both OHCA and IHCA survivors (strong, moderate), replacing earlier framing (e.g., SBP-based/higher MAP goals). Basis: a 2024 meta-analysis concluded evidence supporting MAP targets higher than 60–65 mmHg was insufficient; higher targets may still be individualized in chronic hypertension.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 혈역학 목표가 OHCA·IHCA 생존자 모두 MAP ≥60–65 mmHg로 표준화되었습니다(강한, 중등도). 근거: 2024년 메타분석에서 60–65 mmHg보다 높은 MAP 목표를 지지하는 근거가 불충분하다고 결론지었습니다. 만성 고혈압 환자에서는 더 높은 목표를 개별화할 수 있습니다.

keyChanges.detail: Oxygen management was made explicit: give 100% O2 until reliable SpO2/PaO2 is available (strong; prehospital moderate, in-hospital low), then titrate FiO2 to SaO2 94–98% to avoid hyperoxemia (weak, low). Basis: meta-analyses (~549 prehospital, ~1,059 ICU patients) showed no benefit of lower vs higher oxygenation targets, supporting a titrate-after-stabilization approach rather than early restriction.
keyChanges.detail_ko: 산소 관리가 구체화되었습니다: 신뢰할 SpO2/PaO2가 확보될 때까지 100% 산소를 투여하고(강한; 병원전 중등도, 병원내 낮음), 이후 과산소혈증 방지를 위해 FiO2를 적정해 SaO2 94–98%를 유지합니다(약한, 낮음). 근거: 메타분석(병원전 약 549명, ICU 약 1,059명)에서 낮은 산소목표가 높은 목표 대비 이득이 없어, 조기 제한보다 안정화 후 적정 방식을 지지합니다.

keyChanges.topic: 신경학적 예후 예측 — 다중모드 강조 및 신규 지표
keyChanges.detail: Prognostication shifted to an explicit multimodal framework after removing confounders, reducing reliance on any single test. New/updated items: quantitative pupillometry ≥72 h may be considered (weak, low); EEG reactivity should NOT be used alone (weak, very low); highly malignant EEG patterns (Westhall) and burst suppression after sedation withdrawal added; novel biomarkers GFAP, tau, and neurofilament are NOT suggested (weak, very low), citing limited utility/access. Good-outcome predictors were expanded (GCS motor ≥4 within 4 days, NSE <17 μg/L within 72 h, continuous/near-continuous normal EEG within 72 h, absence of DWI restriction on MRI at 2–7 days).
keyChanges.detail_ko: 예후 예측이 교란요인 제거 후 다중모드 통합 방식으로 전환되어 단일검사 의존을 줄였습니다. 신규·갱신 항목: ≥72h 정량적 동공측정 고려 가능(약한, 낮음), EEG 반응성 단독 사용 금지(약한, 매우 낮음), highly malignant EEG(Westhall)·진정 중단 후 burst suppression 추가, 신규 바이오마커 GFAP·tau·neurofilament는 권고하지 않음(약한, 매우 낮음). 양호 예후 지표도 확장(4일내 GCS 운동 ≥4, 72h내 NSE <17 μg/L, 72h내 연속/거의연속 정상 EEG, 2–7일 MRI DWI 제한 없음).

card.practiceImpact: At the bedside, stop chasing deep hypothermia: set the TTM device anywhere in 33–37.5 °C, hold it ≥24 h, then run strict fever control for 36–72 h with continuous core-temperature feedback. Do not activate the cath lab reflexively for a comatose non-STEMI arrest without shock — get the ECG and echo, treat reversible causes, and reserve emergent angiography for STEMI or cardiogenic shock. Keep SaO2 94–98% and PaCO2 35–45 after initial 100% O2, hold MAP ≥60–65 mmHg, target glucose 144–180 mg/dL, and drop routine prophylactic antibiotics/anticonvulsants/steroids. Never call a poor prognosis off one test — wait ≥72 h, clear sedation and temperature effects, and combine exam, EEG/SSEP, NSE, and CT/MRI.
card.practiceImpact_ko: 침상에서는 더 이상 깊은 저체온을 좇지 않습니다: TTM 장비를 33–37.5 °C 내 어디로든 설정해 최소 24시간 유지하고, 이후 36–72시간 지속 심부체온 피드백으로 엄격한 발열관리를 합니다. 쇼크 없는 비-STEMI 혼수 심정지에서 반사적으로 심도자실을 가동하지 말고 — ECG·심초음파로 가역적 원인을 치료하며, 응급 조영술은 STEMI나 심인성 쇼크로 한정합니다. 초기 100% 산소 후 SaO2 94–98%·PaCO2 35–45를 유지하고, MAP ≥60–65 mmHg, 혈당 144–180 mg/dL를 목표로 하며, 예방적 항생제·항경련제·스테로이드는 일상적으로 쓰지 않습니다. 불량 예후는 단일검사로 판단하지 말고 — ≥72시간 기다리고 진정·체온 영향을 제거한 뒤 진찰·EEG/SSEP·NSE·CT/MRI를 통합해 결정합니다.

published.title: 2025 Korean Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation: Part 4. Adult advanced life support.
published.abstract: The 2025 Korean advanced life support guidelines were updated using a structured evidence evaluation process informed by recent randomized controlled trials and systematic reviews. The guideline development group prioritized patient-important outcomes and assessed the certainty of the evidence to formulate graded recommendations. For drug administration during adult cardiac arrest, intravenous access is the preferred initial route, with intraosseous access recommended when intravenous access cannot be rapidly established. Epinephrine remains the recommended vasopressor. Routine administration of vasopressin, either alone or in combination with corticosteroids, is not recommended for in-hospital or out-of-hospital cardiac arrest. In the absence of specific indications, the routine use of buffering agents and calcium is discouraged owing to insufficient evidence of their benefits and potential harm. Defibrillation recommendations were refined based on emerging evidence. In adults with refractory ventricular fibrillation or pulseless ventricular tachycardia after multiple unsuccessful defibrillation attempts, vector change or double sequential defibrillation may be considered in selected settings when performed by experienced teams with appropriate equipment. Airway management guidelines recommend cricothyroidotomy as a rescue technique when conventional airway management strategies fail. For patients receiving cardiopulmonary resuscitation while on mechanical ventilation, specific ventilator settings during chest compressions are recommended to optimize ventilation and minimize interference with high-quality cardiopulmonary resuscitation. The guidelines also address cardiopulmonary resuscitation-induced consciousness, allowing the cautious use of sedatives and/or analgesic agents when awareness interferes with resuscitation quality or safety. Overall, the guidelines emphasize evidence-based practice and individualized clinical decision-making.
